name: Villaflor (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper hoist to the lower fly, white above with a red cross of Saint James and red below with a white rose.
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially on 20 February 1995 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 48 of 9 March 1995); the flag is rectangular of 2:3, formed of two triangles along the diagonal from the upper hoist corner to the lower fly, the lower red with a white rose and the upper white with a red cross of Saint James.
